sourceFindings: M5-OUT-1 (carried from M5 outOfScopeButFlagged): completion_summaries / failure_analyses / planning_records / memory_cards lack source/imported_at columns mirroring the M4 tasks table. M6 track-1 closes this gap.

M5-OUT-2 (carried from M5 outOfScopeButFlagged): Swift AxiTodoStore.swift reads JSON tasks but does not parse payload.reverse-sync'd source/importedAt as first-class fields. M6 track-2 adds Codable optional fields + JSON round-trip test.

M5-OUT-3 (carried from M5 outOfScopeButFlagged): PG→JSON reverse sync is the missing half of M2's dual-store architecture. Without it, PG data remains orphaned once a JSON-only Swift install does not run the importer. M6 track-3 adds the operator-gated sync tool.

M5-OUT-4 (carried from M5 outOfScopeButFlagged): tools/axi-todo/src/web React deps may have drift between package.json and lockfile; current working tree shows 5 dirty frontend files (DashboardActions / PersonalTodoPage / TodoDashboard / useTaskColumns / useTodoShellConfig) suggesting active dev or uncommitted scratch. M6 track-4 reports the drift without changing it.

M5-OUT-5 (carried from M5 outOfScopeButFlagged): agent-cluster/axi-agent/bin/axi-agent-* hooks are referenced by AGENTS.md but may not all exist; .githooks/ in axi-todo currently has commit-msg/post-commit/pre-commit but not pre-push. M6 track-5 audits and fills obvious gaps.
outOfScopeButFlagged: 接入 PG 的实现细节之外的 Swift 持久化层改造 (Realm / SwiftData / FoundationDB):超出 M6 scope;M6 track-2 只动 JSON 解析 + 字段,不重写 Swift 持久层。
PG→JSON 同步的 scheduled / background 模式:超出 M6 scope;M6 track-3 只提供 owner-gated 一次性手动工具,不接入 daemon / cron。
web 端实际修复 React 依赖 (升级 / 锁版本 / 重写):超出 M6 scope;M6 track-4 只输出 audit JSON,不动 package.json / lockfile / 前端代码。
重构现有 commit-msg / post-commit / pre-commit hooks 内容:超出 M6 scope;M6 track-5 只补缺失的 pre-push / 其他明显缺口,不修改现有 working hooks 的语义。
agent-cluster/axi-agent 下其它跨域代码改动 (backend/ / infra/axi-agent-mcp/ / tools/axi-feishu-codex-bridge/):超出 M6 scope;这些目录的 dirty diff 与本里程碑无关。
